    mentions,
    duty_sentences,

    version_celex,

nodes.sql:
-- Article → article cross-references in the current English text, found by pattern
-- ("Article 16", "Articles 8 to 15"); references to other acts are left out.
with refs as (
    select
        a.article_number as from_article,
        unnest(cast(json(a.article_refs) as varchar[])) as to_article
    from {{ ref('dim_ai_act_article') }} as a
)

    refs.from_article,
    refs.to_article,
    'pattern' as method,
    'derived' as content_type
from refs
join {{ ref('dim_ai_act_article') }} as target on target.article_number = refs.to_article

nodes.name: dim_age_group
nodes.subject: welfare
nodes.description: Age bands as sources publish them. Bands from different sources overlap and are compared only like with like.

columns.name: age_group_key
columns.description: Key: age band as published, such as 15-74, 16+ or ALL (no age breakdown).

columns.name: age_min
columns.description: Attribute: lowest age in the band; years; NULL for ALL.

columns.name: age_max
columns.description: Attribute: highest age in the band; years; NULL for open bands (16+) and ALL.

columns.name: age_group_label
columns.description: Attribute: Swedish display label, such as 16–84 år or Alla åldrar.

nodes.sql:
-- Every age band any welfare fact uses. Bands overlap across sources (AKU 15-74, FK 15-69,
-- Folkhälsomyndigheten 16-84) and are kept as published: a band is only comparable to the
-- same band. ALL marks a source that does not break its count down by age.
with used as (
    select age_group_key from {{ ref('int_welfare_labour_force') }}
    union select age_group_key from {{ ref('int_welfare_sick_pay_rate') }}
    union select age_group_key from {{ ref('int_welfare_sick_leave_cases') }}
    union select age_group_key from {{ ref('int_welfare_health_survey') }}
    union select age_group_key from {{ ref('int_welfare_ess_answers') }} where age_group_key is not null
    union select 'ALL'
    union select '15+'
)
select
    age_group_key,
    case
        when age_group_key = 'ALL' then null
        else cast(regexp_extract(age_group_key, '^(\d+)', 1) as integer)
    end as age_min,
    case
        when regexp_full_match(age_group_key, '\d+-\d+')
            then cast(regexp_extract(age_group_key, '-(\d+)$', 1) as integer)
    end as age_max,
    case
        when age_group_key = 'ALL' then 'Alla åldrar'
        when age_group_key like '%+' then rtrim(age_group_key, '+') || ' år och äldre'
        else replace(age_group_key, '-', '–') || ' år'
    end as age_group_label
from used

nodes.name: dim_ai_act_actor
nodes.subject: ai_act
nodes.description: The Act's actors under their official terms with the Article 3 definition verbatim.

columns.name: actor_id
columns.description: Key: short id of the actor, e.g. 'provider' or 'notified_body' (seeds/eu_ai_act/ai_act_actors.csv).

columns.name: definition
columns.description: Verbatim from Article 3; every actor of the seed must find its definition.

columns.name: official_term
columns.description: Attribute: the actor's term as the Act writes it in English, e.g. 'provider of a general-purpose AI model'.

columns.name: label_en
columns.description: Attribute: display label in English.

columns.name: label_sv
columns.description: Attribute: display label in Swedish.

columns.name: actor_group
columns.description: Attribute: kind of actor, one of operator, body or authority.

columns.name: definition_point
columns.description: Attribute: number of the Article 3 point that defines the actor, e.g. 3 for provider.

columns.name: defined_term
columns.description: Attribute: the term defined at that Article 3 point, verbatim; differs from official_term when the actor is covered by a broader definition.

columns.name: definition_note
columns.description: Attribute: says which Article 3 definition covers the actor when defined_term differs from official_term; null when the actor has its own definition.

columns.name: articles_mentioning
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: distinct articles of the current text whose English text mentions the actor; count of articles, 0 when none.

columns.name: articles_with_duty_sentences
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: distinct articles with at least one sentence where the actor's term is followed by 'shall'; count of articles.

columns.name: match_pattern
columns.description: Attribute: case-insensitive regular expression used to find the actor's term in article text.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.description: Attribute: display order of the actor, 1 first.

columns.name: content_type
columns.description: Attribute: content kind of the row, always 'source'.

nodes.sql:
-- The actors of the AI Act under their official terms, with the definition of Article 3
-- verbatim. A provider of a general-purpose AI model has no definition of its own: it is a
-- provider under Article 3(3), and `definition_note` says so.
with actors as (
    select * from {{ ref('ai_act_actors') }}
),

definitions as (
    select * from {{ ref('int_ai_act_definitions') }}
),

articles as (
    select
        actor_id,
        count(*) as articles_mentioning,
        count(*) filter (where duty_sentences > 0) as articles_with_duty_sentences
    from {{ ref('int_ai_act_article_actors') }}
    group by actor_id
)

select
    a.actor_id,
    a.official_term,
    a.label_en,
    a.label_sv,
    a.actor_group,
    a.definition_point,
    d.term as defined_term,
    d.definition,
    case when d.term <> a.official_term
        then 'Covered by the definition of ‘' || d.term || '’ in Article 3(' || d.point || ')'
    end as definition_note,
    coalesce(s.articles_mentioning, 0) as articles_mentioning,
    coalesce(s.articles_with_duty_sentences, 0) as articles_with_duty_sentences,
    a.match_pattern,
    a.sort_order,
    'source' as content_type
from actors as a
left join definitions as d
    on d.point = cast(a.definition_point as varchar)
left join articles as s on s.actor_id = a.actor_id

nodes.sql:
-- One row per annex of the current consolidated text, English and Swedish, verbatim.
with current_version as (
    select celex from {{ ref('int_ai_act_documents') }} where is_current
)

select
    en.provision_id as annex_id,
    en.number as annex_number,
    en.position,
    en.title as title_en,
    sv.title as title_sv,
    en.text as text_en,
    sv.text as text_sv,
    coalesce(c.change_type, 'unchanged') as change_type,
    en.version_celex,
    'https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:' || en.version_celex
        || '#' || en.provision_id as source_url,
    'source' as content_type
from {{ ref('int_ai_act_provisions') }} as en
join current_version as v on en.version_celex = v.celex
left join {{ ref('int_ai_act_provisions') }} as sv
    on sv.version_celex = en.version_celex and sv.language = 'sv' and sv.provision_id = en.provision_id
left join {{ ref('int_ai_act_provision_changes') }} as c on c.provision_id = en.provision_id
where en.language = 'en' and en.provision_kind = 'annex'

nodes.sql:
-- One row per article of the current consolidated text: English and Swedish title and text
-- verbatim, chapter and section, how it changed since the Official Journal text, and the date
-- from which it applies under Article 113 (seeds/eu_ai_act/ai_act_application_rules.csv, each
-- rule carrying the sentence of Article 113 it rests on).
with current_version as (
    select celex from {{ ref('int_ai_act_documents') }} where is_current
),

en as (
    select p.*
    from {{ ref('int_ai_act_provisions') }} as p
    join current_version as v on p.version_celex = v.celex
    where p.language = 'en' and p.provision_kind = 'article'
),

sv as (
    select p.provision_id, p.title, p.chapter_title, p.section_title, p.text
    from {{ ref('int_ai_act_provisions') }} as p
    join current_version as v on p.version_celex = v.celex
    where p.language = 'sv' and p.provision_kind = 'article'
),

rules as (
    select * from {{ ref('ai_act_application_rules') }}
),

matched as (
    select
        en.provision_id,
        r.rule_id,
        r.applies_from,
        r.applies_from_second,
        r.partial,
        r.source_quote,
        r.note_en,
        r.note_sv,
        row_number() over (partition by en.provision_id order by r.priority desc) as rank
    from en
    join rules as r
        on r.scope = 'all'
        or (r.scope = 'chapter' and r.chapter = en.chapter)
        or (r.scope = 'section' and r.chapter = en.chapter and cast(r.section as varchar) = en.section)
        or (r.scope = 'article'
            and en.number = cast(try_cast(regexp_extract(en.number, '^\d+') as integer) as varchar)
            and try_cast(en.number as integer) between r.article_from and r.article_to)
)

select
    en.provision_id as article_id,
    en.number as article_number,
    try_cast(regexp_extract(en.number, '^\d+') as integer) as article_sort,
    en.position,
    en.title as title_en,
    sv.title as title_sv,
    en.chapter,
    en.chapter_title as chapter_title_en,
    sv.chapter_title as chapter_title_sv,
    en.section,
    en.section_title as section_title_en,
    sv.section_title as section_title_sv,
    en.text as text_en,
    sv.text as text_sv,
    en.char_count,
    coalesce(c.change_type, 'unchanged') as change_type,
    coalesce(c.amended_by, '[]') as amended_by,
    m.rule_id as application_rule_id,
    m.applies_from,
    m.applies_from_second,
    m.partial as applies_partially,
    m.source_quote as application_quote,
    m.note_en as application_note_en,
    m.note_sv as application_note_sv,
    en.article_refs,
    en.annex_refs,
    en.version_celex,
    en.source_hash,
    en.retrieved_at,
    'https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:' || en.version_celex
        || '#' || en.provision_id as source_url,
    'source' as content_type
from en
left join sv on sv.provision_id = en.provision_id
left join {{ ref('int_ai_act_provision_changes') }} as c on c.provision_id = en.provision_id
left join matched as m on m.provision_id = en.provision_id and m.rank = 1

nodes.name: dim_ai_act_document
nodes.subject: ai_act
nodes.description: The AI Act's documents from Cellar; one regulation version is current.

columns.name: document_id
columns.description: Key: the document's CELEX number.

columns.name: source_url
columns.description: Attribute: EUR-Lex URL of the document.

columns.name: published_at
columns.description: Attribute: the document's date in Cellar, ISO date; for the Act itself, the date of its first consolidated version.

columns.name: celex
columns.description: Attribute: the document's CELEX number, same as document_id.

columns.name: relation
columns.description: Attribute: how Cellar links the document to the Act: self, amends, corrects, proposes_to_amend, consolidates, based_on or adopts (the proposal the Act adopts).

columns.name: document_type
columns.description: Attribute: kind of document read from the CELEX number, e.g. regulation, consolidated_version, amending_regulation, corrigendum, original_proposal.

columns.name: document_type_basis
columns.description: Attribute: how document_type was set, always 'derived from the CELEX number'.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Attribute: the document's title from Cellar; for the Act, from the Official Journal text; null when Cellar gives none.

columns.name: title_basis
columns.description: Attribute: where the title comes from: 'Cellar', 'derived from the CELEX number' for corrigenda, or null when there is no title.

columns.name: valid_from
columns.description: Attribute: first day a consolidated version is valid, its Cellar date; null for other documents.

columns.name: valid_to
columns.description: Attribute: last day a consolidated version is valid, the day before the next version; null for the current version and other documents.

columns.name: is_current
columns.description: Attribute: true for the newest consolidated version, the text the article and annex dims are read from.

columns.name: version_hash
columns.description: Attribute: SHA-256 of the fetched English text file; null when no English text was fetched.

columns.name: text_languages
columns.description: Attribute: comma-separated language codes of the fetched texts, e.g. 'en,sv'; null when no text was fetched.

columns.name: retrieved_at
columns.description: Attribute: earliest first fetch of the document's texts; timestamp with time zone, null when no text was fetched.

columns.name: cellar_retrieved_at
columns.description: Attribute: when the Cellar answer listing the document was last fetched; timestamp with time zone.

columns.name: content_type
columns.description: Attribute: content kind of the row, always 'source'.

nodes.sql:
-- Every document of the AI Act's family: the act, its consolidated versions, the acts amending
-- and correcting it, proposals to amend it and acts based on it. Source: Cellar.
select
    document_id,
    celex,
    relation,
    document_type,
    document_type_basis,
    title,
    title_basis,
    published_at,
    valid_from,
    valid_to,
    coalesce(is_current, false) as is_current,
    version_hash,
    text_languages,
    text_retrieved_at as retrieved_at,
    cellar_retrieved_at,
    source_url,
    'source' as content_type
from {{ ref('int_ai_act_documents') }}

columns.description: Attribute: EUR-Lex URL of the Official Journal text, anchored at the recital.

columns.name: content_type
columns.description: Attribute: content kind of the row, always 'source'.

nodes.sql:
-- The recitals of the Official Journal text (consolidated versions carry none), both languages.
select
    en.provision_id as recital_id,
    try_cast(en.number as integer) as recital_number,
    en.text as text_en,
    sv.text as text_sv,
    en.version_celex,
    'https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:' || en.version_celex
        || '#' || en.provision_id as source_url,
    'source' as content_type
from {{ ref('int_ai_act_provisions') }} as en
left join {{ ref('int_ai_act_provisions') }} as sv
    on sv.version_celex = en.version_celex and sv.language = 'sv' and sv.provision_id = en.provision_id
where en.version_celex = '32024R1689' and en.language = 'en' and en.provision_kind = 'recital'

columns.name: corpus_id
columns.description: Key: corpus identifier: myth, philosophy, politics or law.

columns.name: chunks
columns.description: Measure, additive: count of chunks the concept layer sampled from the corpus; at most 500.

columns.name: label_en
columns.description: Attribute: English display name of the corpus.

columns.name: label_sv
columns.description: Attribute: Swedish display name of the corpus.

columns.name: stage
columns.description: Attribute: the corpus's stage in the chain: stories, ideas, contestation or codification.

columns.name: language
columns.description: Attribute: language of the corpus's chunks, en or sv; selects which anchor sentence chunks are compared with.

columns.name: description_en
columns.description: Attribute: English description of what the corpus is and how it was sampled.

columns.name: domain
columns.description: Attribute: site project the corpus comes from: symbolic, philosophy or ai_act.

columns.name: documents
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: distinct count of documents (books, works, speeches, provisions) the sampled chunks come from.

columns.name: first_retrieved_at
columns.description: Attribute: earliest retrieval time of the corpus's sampled chunks; ISO 8601 UTC text, null if the corpus has no chunks.

columns.name: last_retrieved_at
columns.description: Attribute: latest retrieval time of the corpus's sampled chunks; ISO 8601 UTC text, null if the corpus has no chunks.

nodes.sql:
-- The four corpora, their stage in the chain stories → ideas → contestation → codification,
-- and how many chunks of each the concept layer sampled.
select
    c.corpus_id,
    c.label_en,
    c.label_sv,
    c.stage,
    c.language,
    c.description_en,
    c.domain,
    count(k.chunk_id) as chunks,

    min(k.retrieved_at) as first_retrieved_at,
    max(k.retrieved_at) as last_retrieved_at
from {{ ref('corpora') }} as c
left join {{ ref('stg_concept_chunks') }} as k using (corpus_id)

nodes.name: dim_date
nodes.subject: welfare
nodes.description: Calendar, one row per day 1968-2030. Also the semantic layer's time spine.

columns.name: date_day
columns.description: Key: calendar day; ISO date, 1968-01-01 to 2030-12-31.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Attribute: calendar year.

columns.name: quarter
columns.description: Attribute: quarter of the year, 1-4.

columns.name: month
columns.description: Attribute: month of the year, 1-12.

columns.name: year_month
columns.description: Attribute: month as YYYY-MM, matching dim_period month keys.

columns.name: year_quarter
columns.description: Attribute: quarter as YYYY-Qn, matching dim_period quarter keys.

columns.name: month_name_sv
columns.description: Attribute: Swedish month name in lower case, januari to december.

columns.name: iso_day_of_week
columns.description: Attribute: ISO day of week, 1 Monday to 7 Sunday.

columns.name: is_month_start
columns.description: Attribute: true on the first day of a month.

columns.name: is_month_end
columns.description: Attribute: true on the last day of a month.

nodes.sql:
-- Calendar, one row per day from the earliest population year to 2030. Periods of any
-- length join here through dim_period's start and end dates.
select
    cast(day as date) as date_day,
    year(day) as year,
    quarter(day) as quarter,
    month(day) as month,
    strftime(day, '%Y-%m') as year_month,
    year(day) || '-Q' || quarter(day) as year_quarter,
    ['januari', 'februari', 'mars', 'april', 'maj', 'juni', 'juli', 'augusti',
     'september', 'oktober', 'november', 'december'][month(day)] as month_name_sv,
    isodow(day) as iso_day_of_week,
    day(day) = 1 as is_month_start,
    day = last_day(day) as is_month_end
from generate_series(date '1968-01-01', date '2030-12-31', interval 1 day) as days(day)

nodes.name: dim_indicator
nodes.subject: welfare
nodes.description: Every indicator in fct_indicator, with unit, welfare domain and direction.

columns.name: indicator_key
columns.description: Key: source prefix plus code, such as aku_unemployment_rate, ess_ppltrst or kolada_N03937.

columns.name: source_key
columns.description: Foreign key to dim_source: the publishing source (scb, fk, fohm, ess, kolada).

columns.name: domain
columns.description: Attribute: finer welfare area used on the site, such as jobb or mental_halsa.
tests: accepted values: jobb, arbetsliv, ekonomi, politik, mental_halsa, halsa, tillit_varderingar, trygghet, utbildning, befolkning

columns.name: measure_type
columns.description: count_flow (add over time and space), count_stock (add over space, not time), rate and share (non-additive: recompute from components or weight), mean_score (survey mean), median (not aggregable).
tests: accepted values: count_flow, count_stock, rate, share, mean_score, median

columns.name: time_rule
columns.description: How values over periods combine into a longer period.
tests: accepted values: sum, mean_of_periods, end_of_period, recompute_from_components, not_aggregable

columns.name: space_rule
columns.description: How values over regions, sexes or ages combine.
tests: accepted values: sum, recompute_from_components, population_weighted_mean, recompute_from_microdata, not_aggregable

columns.name: source_code
columns.description: Attribute: the source's own code for the indicator (AKU status, FoHM measure, ESS variable, Kolada KPI id).

columns.name: indicator_name
columns.description: Attribute: indicator name in Swedish.

columns.name: unit
columns.description: Attribute: unit of fct_indicator.value in Swedish (procent, antal, medelvärde 0-10); NULL for Kolada, see description.

columns.name: welfare_dimension
columns.description: Attribute: dimension as in SCB's Nya mått på välfärd, such as ekonomisk or social.

columns.name: higher_is_better
columns.description: Attribute: true when a higher value is better, false when worse; NULL when no direction applies.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Attribute: Swedish description of what the indicator measures; Kolada's KPI description for Kolada.

columns.name: weight_indicator
columns.description: Attribute: indicator_key to weight by when combining regions (scb_population for FoHM); NULL when none.

columns.name: components
columns.description: Attribute: formula of the indicator's additive components in the facts, for recomputing; NULL when none.

columns.name: aggregation_note
columns.description: Attribute: plain-English rule for aggregating the indicator correctly.

nodes.sql:
-- Every indicator in fct_indicator: its source, unit, welfare domain and direction, and how
-- it may be aggregated (seeds/welfare/indicator_aggregation.csv; survey indicators follow
-- source-wide rules below). `welfare_dimension` groups indicators as SCB's Nya mått på
-- välfärd does; `domain` is the finer area used on the site.
with indicators as (
select indicator_key, source_key, source_code, indicator_name, unit, domain,
       welfare_dimension, higher_is_better, description
from {{ ref('indicators') }}
union all
select
    'fohm_' || m.topic || '_' || m.measure_code,
    'fohm',
    m.measure_code,
    first(l.measure_label),
    'procent',
    m.domain,
    'social',
    m.higher_is_better,
    'Andel av befolkningen enligt Nationella folkhälsoenkäten. Län: 16-84 år, fyra år sammanslagna.'
from {{ ref('fohm_measures') }} as m
join {{ ref('stg_fohm_measures') }} as l
    on l.measure_code = m.measure_code and l.source_table like 'hlv1' || m.topic || '%'
group by m.topic, m.measure_code, m.domain, m.higher_is_better
union all
select
    'ess_' || variable, 'ess', variable, name_sv,
    'medelvärde ' || scale_min || '-' || scale_max,
    domain, 'social', higher_is_better,
    name_en || '. Viktat medelvärde (pspwght) per land och omgång.'
from {{ ref('ess_variables') }}
union all
select
    'kolada_' || k.kpi_id, 'kolada', k.kpi_id, m.kpi_title,
    null, k.domain, k.welfare_dimension, k.higher_is_better, m.kpi_description
from {{ ref('kolada_kpis') }} as k
join {{ ref('stg_kolada_kpis') }} as m using (kpi_id)
)
select
    i.*,
    coalesce(a.measure_type, case i.source_key when 'fohm' then 'share' when 'ess' then 'mean_score' end)
        as measure_type,
    coalesce(a.time_rule, 'not_aggregable') as time_rule,
    coalesce(a.space_rule, case i.source_key
        when 'fohm' then 'population_weighted_mean'
        when 'ess' then 'recompute_from_microdata' end) as space_rule,
    coalesce(a.weight_indicator, case when i.source_key = 'fohm' then 'scb_population' end)
        as weight_indicator,
    a.components,
    coalesce(a.aggregation_note, case i.source_key
        when 'fohm' then 'Population-weighted survey estimate. County values pool four years and cannot be split into years or added over periods. Across counties a population-weighted mean approximates the national estimate; FoHM publishes the national value, use it.'
        when 'ess' then 'Weighted respondent means. Aggregate only from respondents (silver.int_welfare_ess_answers): pspwght within a country, anweight (pspwght x pweight) when pooling countries. Never average country means.'
    end) as aggregation_note
from indicators as i
left join {{ ref('indicator_aggregation') }} as a using (indicator_key)

nodes.name: dim_issue

columns.name: issue_key
columns.description: Key: short Swedish key of the policy issue, such as arbete or bostad; from seeds/parliament/issues.csv.

columns.description: Attribute: Swedish name of the issue.

columns.description: Attribute: English name of the issue.

nodes.sql:
-- Policy issues: the committees that handle them, the budget expenditure areas (utgiftsområden)
-- they decide, and the welfare indicators that describe the outcome they concern. The links
-- are for reading side by side; none of them is a claim that a decision caused a figure.
select
    i.issue_key, i.issue_name_sv, i.issue_name_en, i.summary_sv,
    [cast(area as integer) for area in string_split(i.expenditure_areas, '|')] as expenditure_areas,
    case when i.welfare_indicators is not null
         then string_split(i.welfare_indicators, '|') else [] end as welfare_indicators,
    -- Standing committees first, joint committees after.
    list(c.committee_code order by c.active_note is not null and c.active_note like 'Sammansatt%', c.committee_code) as committees
from {{ ref('issues') }} as i
left join {{ ref('committees') }} as c using (issue_key)
group by all

nodes.sql:
-- Occupation groups (SSYK 4) as the ads name them, each in its occupation field. A group's
-- label and field are those of its latest month, so a renamed group keeps one row.
select
    group_id,
    arg_max(ssyk, month) as ssyk,
    arg_max(occupation_group, month) as occupation_group,
    arg_max(field_id, month) as field_id,
    arg_max(field, month) as field,
    min(month) as first_month,

from {{ ref('stg_market_ads') }}
where group_id is not null
group by group_id

nodes.sql:
-- One row per SCB municipality code in use since 1974: today's 290 from dim_region, and the
-- 51 codes retired by the 1977 Bara merger and the 1997, 1998 and 2007 renumberings
-- (seeds/shared/municipality_codes). A retired code carries its successor and the
-- successor's county, NUTS2 area and name; only Bara has a name of its own.
with codes as (
    select * from {{ ref('municipality_codes') }}
), current_codes as (
    select
        r.region_code as municipality_code,
        r.region_name as municipality_name,
        r.county_code,
        r.county_name,
        r.nuts2_code,
        r.nuts2_name,
        r.kolada_region_id,
        coalesce(c.valid_from, 1974) as valid_from,
        cast(null as integer) as valid_to,
        cast(null as varchar) as successor_code,
        cast(null as varchar) as change_type
    from {{ ref('dim_region') }} as r
    left join codes as c on c.municipality_code = r.region_code
    where r.region_level = 'municipality'
)
select * from current_codes
union all
select
    c.municipality_code,
    c.retired_name,
    s.county_code,
    s.county_name,
    s.nuts2_code,
    s.nuts2_name,
    null,
    c.valid_from,
    c.valid_to,
    c.successor_code,
    c.change_type
from codes as c
left join current_codes as s on s.municipality_code = c.successor_code
where c.valid_to is not null

-- Riksmöten from 1993/94: when each ran, the election it followed and who governed at its start.
with sessions as (
    select session, min(vote_date) as first_vote, max(vote_date) as last_vote,
           count(*) as roll_calls
    from {{ ref('int_parliament_roll_calls') }}
    group by session
), elections as (
    select distinct election_year from {{ ref('fct_election') }}
)
select
    s.session,
    cast(left(s.session, 4) as integer) as start_year,
    s.first_vote, s.last_vote, s.roll_calls,
    (select max(election_year) from elections as e
     where e.election_year <= cast(left(s.session, 4) as integer)) as election_year,
    g.government_key, g.government_name, g.government_parties, g.agreement_parties
from sessions as s
left join {{ ref('dim_government') }} as g
    on s.first_vote >= g.start_date and s.first_vote < coalesce(g.end_date, date '9999-12-31')

nodes.name: dim_period
nodes.subject: welfare
nodes.description: Reporting periods: year (2024), quarter (2024-Q1), month (2024-03), pooled_years (2021-2024, Folkhälsomyndigheten's county results) and survey_round (ESS11). start_date and end_date join dim_date; reference_year aligns periods of different types.

columns.name: period_key

tests: accepted values: year, quarter, month, pooled_years, survey_round

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Foreign key to dim_date: first day of the period; for an ESS round, 1 January of the fieldwork start year.

columns.name: end_date
columns.description: Foreign key to dim_date: last day of the period; for an ESS round, 31 December of the fieldwork end year.

columns.name: reference_year
columns.description: Attribute: year the period is compared under; the last year of a pooled span, an ESS round's nominal year.

columns.name: period_label
columns.description: Attribute: display label; the key itself, with fieldwork years added for ESS rounds.

nodes.sql:
-- Every reporting period any welfare fact uses, with its start and end date. Sources
-- report at different grains, so a fact carries a period, not a date:
--   year 2024 | quarter 2024-Q1 | month 2024-03 | pooled_years 2021-2024 | survey_round ESS11
-- `reference_year` is the year a period is compared under: the year itself, the last year
-- of a pooled period, and an ESS round's nominal year.
with used as (
    select period_key from {{ ref('int_welfare_labour_force') }}
    union select period_key from {{ ref('int_welfare_population') }}
    union select period_key from {{ ref('int_welfare_sick_pay_rate') }}
    union select period_key from {{ ref('int_welfare_sick_leave_cases') }}
    union select period_key from {{ ref('int_welfare_health_survey') }}
    union select period_key from {{ ref('int_welfare_kolada') }}
    union select period_key from {{ ref('int_welfare_ess_answers') }}
), typed as (
    select
        period_key,
        case
            when regexp_full_match(period_key, '\d{4}') then 'year'
            when regexp_full_match(period_key, '\d{4}-Q[1-4]') then 'quarter'
            when regexp_full_match(period_key, '\d{4}-\d{2}') then 'month'
            when regexp_full_match(period_key, '\d{4}-\d{4}') then 'pooled_years'
            when regexp_full_match(period_key, 'ESS\d+') then 'survey_round'
        end as period_type
    from used
)
select
    t.period_key,
    t.period_type,
    case t.period_type
        when 'year' then make_date(cast(t.period_key as integer), 1, 1)
        when 'quarter' then make_date(cast(left(t.period_key, 4) as integer),
                                      cast(right(t.period_key, 1) as integer) * 3 - 2, 1)
        when 'month' then cast(t.period_key || '-01' as date)
        when 'pooled_years' then make_date(cast(left(t.period_key, 4) as integer), 1, 1)
        when 'survey_round' then make_date(cast(left(r.fieldwork_label, 4) as integer), 1, 1)
    end as start_date,
    case t.period_type
        when 'year' then make_date(cast(t.period_key as integer), 12, 31)
        when 'quarter' then last_day(make_date(cast(left(t.period_key, 4) as integer),
                                               cast(right(t.period_key, 1) as integer) * 3, 1))
        when 'month' then last_day(cast(t.period_key || '-01' as date))
        when 'pooled_years' then make_date(cast(right(t.period_key, 4) as integer), 12, 31)
        when 'survey_round' then make_date(cast(right(r.fieldwork_label, 4) as integer), 12, 31)
    end as end_date,
    case t.period_type
        when 'pooled_years' then cast(right(t.period_key, 4) as integer)
        when 'survey_round' then r.reference_year
        else cast(left(t.period_key, 4) as integer)
    end as reference_year,
    case t.period_type
        when 'survey_round' then t.period_key || ' (' || r.fieldwork_label || ')'
        else t.period_key
    end as period_label
from typed as t
left join {{ ref('ess_rounds') }} as r
    on t.period_type = 'survey_round' and r.essround = try_cast(substr(t.period_key, 4) as integer)

columns.description: SCB region code: 00 the country, two digits a county, four digits a municipality, 0050 an aggregate. Facts name it region_code, or municipality_code when only municipalities occur.

columns.name: region_level

tests: accepted values: country, county, municipality, aggregate, nuts2

columns.name: county_code
columns.description: The county a county or municipality belongs to; NULL for other levels.

columns.name: nuts2_code
columns.description: NUTS2 area of a county or municipality, and of a NUTS2 row itself.

columns.name: kolada_region_id
columns.description: Kolada's id for the same region (0000, 00LL, KKKK).

columns.name: region_name
columns.description: Attribute: region name as SCB publishes it, or the NUTS2 area name.

columns.description: Attribute: name of the county a county or municipality belongs to; NULL for other levels.

columns.name: nuts2_name
columns.description: Attribute: name of the NUTS2 area (riksområde); NULL when the region has none.

nodes.sql:
-- Swedish regions on SCB's codes: the country (00), counties (two digits), municipalities
-- (four digits, the first two being the county), AKU's aggregate 0050, and the eight NUTS2
-- areas (SE11..SE33) that ESS reports. Each row carries its county, NUTS2 area and Kolada id.
with scb as (
    select region_code, region_name from {{ ref('stg_scb_regions') }}
    union
    select region_code, region_name from {{ ref('stg_scb_aku_regions') }}
), levelled as (
    select
        region_code,
        region_name,
        case
            when region_code = '00' then 'country'
            when length(region_code) = 2 then 'county'
            when region_code = '0050' then 'aggregate'
            else 'municipality'
        end as region_level
    from scb
), counties as (
    select region_code as county_code, region_name as county_name
    from levelled where region_level = 'county'
), nuts2 as (
    select distinct nuts2_code, nuts2_name from {{ ref('region_nuts') }}
)
select
    l.region_code,
    l.region_name,
    l.region_level,
    c.county_code,
    c.county_name,
    n.nuts2_code,
    n.nuts2_name,
    case l.region_level
        when 'country' then '0000'
        when 'county' then '00' || l.region_code
        when 'municipality' then l.region_code
    end as kolada_region_id
from levelled as l
left join counties as c
    on l.region_level in ('county', 'municipality') and c.county_code = left(l.region_code, 2)
left join {{ ref('region_nuts') }} as n on n.county_code = c.county_code
union all
select nuts2_code, nuts2_name, 'nuts2', null, null, nuts2_code, nuts2_name, null
from nuts2

columns.name: kind
columns.description: Attribute: sou, ds, rir (Riksrevisionen) or pm (ministry memorandum, promemoria).

columns.name: year
columns.description: Attribute: series year of the report; for a memorandum, the year of the earliest bill that names it.

columns.name: number
columns.description: Attribute: number of the report in its series year; null for a memorandum.

columns.description: Attribute: series and number as written, such as SOU 2026:56; a memorandum's title or 'Promemoria <diary>'.

columns.name: diary
columns.description: Attribute: ministry diary number (diarienummer) of a memorandum; null for series reports.

columns.description: Attribute: title of the study; null for a series report known only from a bill's citation.

columns.name: inquiry
columns.description: Attribute: the inquiry that wrote the report, read from Riksdagen's notice text; null when not stated.

columns.name: published
columns.description: Attribute: publication date from Riksdagen's listing; null for memoranda and cited-only reports.

columns.name: source_url
columns.description: Attribute: Riksdagen document URL; for a memorandum, the citing bill's URL; for a cited-only report, a Riksdagen search URL.

nodes.sql:
-- Every government study a bill can rest on: the published series (SOU, Ds, RiR) from
-- Riksdagen's listings, the ministry memoranda (promemorior) that bills name in their
-- preparation but that no series lists (known by title or diary number), and the few series
-- reports a bill names that the listings lack, known only by their number.
with memoranda as (
    select
        'pm:' || lower(r.key) as study_key,
        'pm' as kind,
        min(year(b.bill_date)) as year,
        cast(null as integer) as number,
        coalesce(nullif(r.title, ''), 'Promemoria ' || r.diary) as designation,
        max(r.diary) as diary,
        coalesce(nullif(r.title, ''), 'Promemoria ' || r.diary) as title,
        cast(null as varchar) as inquiry,
        cast(null as date) as published,
        -- A memorandum has no document of its own in Riksdagen's data; the bill is its source.
        min(b.source_url) as source_url
    from {{ ref('stg_riksdagen_bill_preparation') }} as b, unnest(b."references") as t(r)
    where r.kind = 'pm'
    group by 1, 2, 5, 7
), listed as (
    select study_key, kind, year, number, designation, cast(null as varchar) as diary, title,
           inquiry, published, source_url
    from {{ ref('stg_riksdagen_studies') }}
), cited_only as (
    select distinct
        r.kind || ':' || r.key as study_key,
        r.kind,
        cast(split_part(r.key, ':', 1) as integer) as year,
        cast(split_part(r.key, ':', 2) as integer) as number,
        case r.kind when 'rir' then 'RiR' when 'ds' then 'Ds' else upper(r.kind) end
            || ' ' || r.key as designation,
        cast(null as varchar) as diary,
        cast(null as varchar) as title,
        cast(null as varchar) as inquiry,
        cast(null as date) as published,
        'https://www.riksdagen.se/sv/sok/?doktyp=' || r.kind || '&q='
            || replace(r.key, ':', '%3A') as source_url
    from {{ ref('stg_riksdagen_bill_preparation') }} as b, unnest(b."references") as t(r)
    where r.kind in ('sou', 'ds', 'rir')
      and r.kind || ':' || r.key not in (select study_key from listed)
)
select * from listed
union all
select study_key, kind, year, number, designation, diary, title, inquiry, published, source_url
from memoranda
union all
select * from cited_only

columns.description: Attribute: Riksdagen document URL for the decision's bill or report.

nodes.sql:
-- Riksdag decisions that changed Swedish taxes, 2007 on: what changed, from when, in which
-- direction, the bill it came from and the committee report it was decided in. The seed
-- names each decision from the budget bills' chapters on taxes and the enacted law text; a
-- decision taken on the committee's own proposal or a reservation has no bill.
select
    d.decision_key,
    cast(d.in_force as date) as in_force,
    year(cast(d.in_force as date)) as in_force_year,
    d.component,
    d.direction,
    d.title_sv,
    d.title_en,
    nullif(d.bill, '') as bill,
    nullif(d.bill_section, '') as bill_section,
    b.title as bill_title,
    b.bill_date,
    b.department,
    d.report,
    split_part(d.report, ':', 1) as report_session,
    split_part(d.report, ':', 2) as report_designation,
    d.origin,
    -- For a tax on motor fuel: the change per litre, excluding VAT, and the months of the
    -- year it applied (for a temporary change), as the bill states them.
    d.petrol_sek_per_litre,
    d.diesel_sek_per_litre,
    d.months,
    d.source_url
from {{ ref('tax_decisions') }} as d
left join {{ ref('fct_bill') }} as b on b.bill = d.bill

-- Every chunk the concept layer read, with full provenance. The text is the source's own

nodes.name: fct_ai_speech

nodes.description: One row per speech, whether it mentions AI and whether it names the AI Act; the denominator for every share.

columns.description: Key: Riksdag speech id, protocol document id and speech number joined by a hyphen.

columns.description: Foreign key to dim_parliament_session: the Riksdag session (riksmöte) of the speech, for example 2023/24.

columns.description: Attribute: date of the speech, ISO date.

columns.description: Attribute: first day of the speech's month.

columns.description: Attribute: calendar year of the speech.

columns.description: Attribute: kind of chamber activity, as in Riksdagen's export (kammaraktivitet).

columns.description: Measure, additive: count of the speech's paragraphs that pass the AI gate; 0 when none.

columns.name: mentions_ai
columns.description: Attribute: true when at least one paragraph passes the AI gate (a dictionary match, not a reading).

columns.name: names_ai_act
columns.description: Attribute: true when an AI paragraph names the AI Act; a speech can discuss the Act without naming it.

nodes.sql:
-- One row per Riksdag speech with whether it is about AI (any paragraph passes the AI gate) and
-- whether it names the AI Act. The denominator for every share in this subject.
with ai as (
    select
        speech_id,
        count(*) as ai_paragraphs,
        bool_or(names_ai_act) as names_ai_act
    from {{ ref('int_ai_speech_paragraphs') }}
    group by speech_id
)

select
    s.speech_id,
    s.session,
    s.speech_date,
    s.speech_month,
    s.speech_year,
    s.party,
    s.speaker,
    s.debate_title,
    s.debate_kind,
    s.word_count,
    coalesce(ai.ai_paragraphs, 0) as ai_paragraphs,
    ai.speech_id is not null as mentions_ai,
    coalesce(ai.names_ai_act, false) as names_ai_act,
    s.source_url
from {{ ref('int_riksdag_speeches') }} as s
left join ai on ai.speech_id = s.speech_id

columns.name: chunk_b

columns.name: similarity
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: cosine similarity of the two chunks' embeddings; -1 to 1.

columns.name: baseline_mean
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: mean cosine similarity of 4,000 random chunk pairs between the two corpora; same for every concept.

-- chunks, with the random-pair baseline for those corpora. Semantic similarity of wording,
-- not influence or shared meaning.

nodes.name: fct_election
nodes.subject: parliament
nodes.description: Riksdag election results, Sweden, 1973 to the latest election. SCB where it has published, Valmyndigheten otherwise. Ny demokrati's votes (1991, 1994) are inside OTHER in SCB's tables; its seats are its own row.

columns.name: party
columns.description: Key, references dim_party: party abbreviation; small parties summed into OTHER.

columns.name: election_year
columns.description: Key: year of the Riksdag election.

columns.name: votes
columns.description: Measure, additive: count of valid votes for the party in the whole country; null for Ny demokrati 1991 and 1994, whose votes are in OTHER.

columns.name: share_pct
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: share of valid votes; per cent 0-100.

columns.name: seats
columns.description: Measure, additive: count of Riksdag seats won; 0 when none.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Attribute: SCB or Valmyndigheten, where the row comes from.

nodes.sql:
-- Riksdag election results for the whole country, one row per election and party: votes, share
-- of valid votes and seats. SCB for 1973-2022; Valmyndigheten for an election SCB has not yet
-- published. Small parties are summed into OTHER; blank and invalid ballots are left out.
with scb_votes as (
    select election_year, party, votes, share_pct
    from {{ ref('stg_scb_elections') }}
    where region_code = '00' and party_code not in ('OGILTIGA', 'VALSKOLKARE')
), scb as (
    -- A full join: SCB's vote table has no row for Ny demokrati (1991, 1994), whose votes sit
    -- in ÖVRIGA, while its seat table does. Its seats are kept; its votes stay in OTHER.
    select coalesce(v.election_year, s.election_year) as election_year,
           coalesce(v.party, s.party) as party, v.votes, v.share_pct, s.seats, 'SCB' as source
    from scb_votes as v
    full join {{ ref('stg_scb_election_seats') }} as s using (election_year, party)
    where coalesce(v.votes, 0) > 0 or coalesce(s.seats, 0) > 0
), val as (
    select election_year, party, sum(votes) as votes, sum(share_pct) as share_pct,
           sum(seats) as seats, 'Valmyndigheten' as source
    from {{ ref('stg_val_riksdag_result') }}
    where election_year not in (select election_year from scb)
    group by election_year, party
)
select election_year, case when party = 'ÖVRIGA' then 'OTHER' else party end as party,
       votes, share_pct, coalesce(seats, 0) as seats, source
from scb
union all
select election_year, party, votes, round(share_pct, 2), coalesce(seats, 0), source from val

from {{ ref('stg_scb_elections') }}

nodes.name: fct_household_vat
nodes.subject: taxes
nodes.description: Estimated VAT per household type and spending group (SCB HUT and VAT rates).

columns.name: vat_rate
columns.description: VAT rate in per cent (25 = 25 %).

columns.name: household_type
columns.description: Key: SCB HUT household type code, e.g. E90 for all households.

columns.name: household_sv
columns.description: Attribute: household type name in Swedish.

columns.name: household_en
columns.description: Attribute: household type name in English.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Key: survey year of the spending figures.

columns.name: spending_group
columns.description: Key: SCB HUT code of the group of goods and services.

columns.name: name_sv
columns.description: Attribute: spending group name in Swedish.

columns.name: name_en
columns.description: Attribute: spending group name in English.

columns.name: sek_per_household
columns.description: Measure, additive: spending on the group per household in the year, prices including VAT; SEK.

columns.name: vat_sek
columns.description: Measure, additive: estimated VAT in that spending, sek_per_household * rate / (100 + rate); SEK per household per year.

columns.name: note_sv
columns.description: Attribute: note in Swedish on the rate, e.g. a later rate change; null when none.

nodes.sql:
-- An estimate of the VAT a household pays in a year: its spending per group (SCB HUT), prices
-- including VAT, times rate / (1 + rate). Only groups with one clear rate are counted; rent,
-- health care, insurance, interest and fees carry no VAT or a mix and are left out, so the
-- estimate is a floor, not a total.
select
    s.household_type,
    h.name_sv as household_sv,
    h.name_en as household_en,
    s.year,
    s.spending_group,
    g.name_sv,
    g.name_en,
    g.vat_rate,
    s.sek_per_household,
    s.sek_per_household * g.vat_rate / (100 + g.vat_rate) as vat_sek,
    g.note_sv
from {{ ref('stg_scb_household_spending') }} as s
join {{ ref('household_types') }} as h using (household_type)
join {{ ref('vat_spending_groups') }} as g on g.spending_group = s.spending_group

nodes.name: fct_indicator
nodes.subject: welfare
nodes.description: All headline values on one grain. The table to join across domains.

columns.name: indicator_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_indicator: which indicator the value measures; unit and aggregation rules live in dim_indicator.

columns.name: region_code
columns.description: Key, references dim_region: SCB region code: 00 country, county, municipality, 0050 or a NUTS2 area, per source.

columns.name: period_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_period: year, quarter, month, pooled years or ESS round, depending on the source.

columns.name: sex_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_sex: T total, K women, M men.

columns.name: age_group_key
columns.description: Key, references dim_age_group: age band as the source publishes it; ALL where the source has no age breakdown.

columns.name: value
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: headline value in the indicator's own unit (see dim_indicator.unit and measure_type).

columns.name: ci_low
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: lower interval bound in the value's unit (AKU rate minus margin, FoHM or ESS 95% bound); NULL for other sources.

columns.name: ci_high
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: upper interval bound in the value's unit (AKU rate plus margin, FoHM or ESS 95% bound); NULL for other sources.

columns.name: sample_size
columns.description: Measure, additive: FoHM responses or ESS respondents behind the value; count of responses; NULL for register sources.

nodes.sql:
-- Every headline value from every welfare source on one grain:
--   indicator x region x period x sex x age group
-- This is the table to join across domains: filter dim_indicator by domain, dim_region
-- by level, dim_period by type. Values keep their source's unit (see dim_indicator), and
-- periods differ by source; compare like with like through dim_period.reference_year.
with aku as (
    select
        case
            when labour_status = 'unemployed' and series_type = 'unadjusted' then 'aku_unemployment_rate'
            when labour_status = 'employed' and series_type = 'unadjusted' then 'aku_employment_rate'
            when labour_status = 'labour_force' and series_type = 'unadjusted' then 'aku_labour_force_participation'
            when labour_status = 'unemployed' and series_type = 'seasonally_adjusted' then 'aku_unemployment_rate_sa'
            when labour_status = 'employed' and series_type = 'seasonally_adjusted' then 'aku_employment_rate_sa'
        end as indicator_key,
        region_code, period_key, sex_key, age_group_key,
        rate_pct as value,
        rate_pct - rate_pct_moe as ci_low,
        rate_pct + rate_pct_moe as ci_high,
        null::double as sample_size
    from {{ ref('fct_labour_force') }}
    where rate_pct is not null
), fk_cases as (
    select
        case
            when case_type = 'ongoing' and diagnosis_code = 'ALL' then 'fk_ongoing_sick_leave'
            when case_type = 'started' and diagnosis_code = 'ALL' then 'fk_started_sick_leave'

        null::double, null::double, null::double
    from {{ ref('fct_sick_leave_cases') }}
    where cases is not null
)
select * from aku where indicator_key is not null
union all
select 'scb_population', region_code, period_key, sex_key, 'ALL', population, null, null, null
from {{ ref('fct_population') }}
union all
select 'fk_sick_pay_rate', region_code, period_key, sex_key, age_group_key, sick_pay_rate, null, null, null
from {{ ref('fct_sick_pay_rate') }}
where sick_pay_rate is not null

nodes.name: fct_library_municipality_year
nodes.subject: sweden
nodes.description: Public libraries per municipality and year: the four bibstat totals (NULL when partial or an impossible zero, named in set_to_missing) and the population denominator.

columns.name: municipality_code
columns.description: Key, references dim_municipality: SCB four-digit municipality code of the reporting libraries.

columns.name: population
columns.description: gold.mart_municipality_year_panel's population that year, or the year before.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Key: bibstat sample year.

columns.name: service_points
columns.description: Measure, additive: staffed service points (BemanService01); NULL when an organisation did not report it or the zero is impossible (see set_to_missing); count.

columns.name: visits
columns.description: Measure, additive: physical library visits (Besok01); NULL when an organisation did not report it or the zero is impossible (see set_to_missing); count.

columns.name: activities
columns.description: Measure, additive: public activities (Publ199); NULL when an organisation did not report it; count.

columns.name: active_borrowers
columns.description: Measure, additive: active borrowers (Aktiv99); NULL when an organisation did not report it; count.

columns.name: set_to_missing
columns.description: Attribute: list naming each total set to NULL and why (partial report or impossible zero); empty when none.

nodes.sql:
-- Public libraries per municipality and year (KB's bibstat): staffed service points, physical
-- visits, public activities and active borrowers, with the municipal population as denominator.
-- A total is NULL when one of the municipality's reporting organisations omitted the term that
-- year (the sum would be partial), and zero visits with staffed service points, or zero service
-- points with visits, are NULL rather than zero; set_to_missing names each such value.
{% set measures = ['service_points', 'visits', 'activities', 'active_borrowers'] %}
with observations as (
    select * from {{ ref('fct_library_observation') }}
    where municipality_code is not null and value is not null
), organisations as (
    select municipality_code, year, count(distinct sigel) as organisations
    from observations group by all
), sums as (
    -- bibstat's four terms are counts.
    select municipality_code, year, measure, cast(sum(value) as bigint) as total,
           count(distinct sigel) as reporters
    from observations group by all
), complete as (
    select
        o.municipality_code, o.year,
        {% for m in measures %}
        max(s.total) filter (where s.measure = '{{ m }}' and s.reporters = o.organisations) as {{ m }},
        bool_or(s.measure = '{{ m }}' and s.reporters < o.organisations) as {{ m }}_partial{{ ',' if not loop.last }}
        {% endfor %}
    from organisations as o
    join sums as s using (municipality_code, year)
    group by all
), population as (
    select municipality_code, year, population
    from {{ ref('mart_municipality_year_panel') }}
    where population is not null
)
select
    c.municipality_code,
    c.year,
    case when c.service_points = 0 and c.visits <> 0 then null else c.service_points end as service_points,
    case when c.visits = 0 and c.service_points <> 0 then null else c.visits end as visits,
    c.activities,
    c.active_borrowers,
    -- The year's population, or the year before's while SCB has not published it.
    coalesce(p.population, p_before.population) as population,
    list_filter([
        {% for m in measures %}
        case when c.{{ m }}_partial then '{{ m }}: an organisation did not report' end,
        {% endfor %}
        case when c.visits = 0 and c.service_points <> 0 then 'visits: 0 with staffed service points' end,
        case when c.service_points = 0 and c.visits <> 0 then 'service_points: 0 with visits' end
    ], x -> x is not null) as set_to_missing
from complete as c
left join population as p on p.municipality_code = c.municipality_code and p.year = c.year
left join population as p_before on p_before.municipality_code = c.municipality_code and p_before.year = c.year - 1

nodes.name: fct_library_observation
nodes.subject: sweden
nodes.description: Public-library observations (Folkbibliotek, Folk- och skolbibliotek) of bibstat's BemanService01, Besok01, Publ199 and Aktiv99, one per library, year and term.

columns.name: observation_id
columns.description: Key: bibstat observation id (@id).

columns.name: measure
columns.description: Attribute: the term's name here: service_points, visits, activities or active_borrowers.

columns.name: municipality_code
columns.description: NULL when Biblioteksdatabasen gives the library no current municipality.

columns.name: term
columns.description: Attribute: bibstat term code: BemanService01, Besok01, Publ199 or Aktiv99.

columns.name: sigel
columns.description: Foreign key to dim_library: the reporting library's sigel.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Attribute: bibstat sample year of the observation.

columns.name: value
columns.description: Measure, additive: the observation's count for the term; NULL when bibstat has no number.

nodes.sql:
-- Public-library observations of the four bibstat terms SWEDEN D uses, with the municipality
-- Biblioteksdatabasen gives the reporting organisation. municipality_code is NULL when the
-- library has none or a code that is not current; value is NULL when bibstat has no number.
-- bibstat holds a few repeated submissions (Lindängenbiblioteket 2016: two observations with
-- the same values); only the first observation id of each library, year and term is kept.
select
    o.observation_id,
    o.term,
    case o.term
        when 'BemanService01' then 'service_points'
        when 'Besok01' then 'visits'
        when 'Publ199' then 'activities'
        when 'Aktiv99' then 'active_borrowers'
    end as measure,
    o.sigel,
    o.sample_year as year,
    m.municipality_code,
    o.value
from {{ ref('stg_kb_statistics') }} as o
left join {{ ref('dim_library') }} as l on l.sigel = o.sigel
left join {{ ref('dim_municipality') }} as m
    on m.municipality_code = l.municipality_code and m.valid_to is null
where o.term in ('BemanService01', 'Besok01', 'Publ199', 'Aktiv99')
  and o.target_group in ('Folkbibliotek', 'Folk- och skolbibliotek')
qualify row_number() over (partition by o.sigel, o.sample_year, o.term order by o.observation_id) = 1

columns.name: pc2

nodes.sql:
-- SWEDEN C's inputs per municipality for the clustering's reference year (2024): the twelve
-- indicator values it was fitted on, from the panel copy it hashed and Kolada's four extra key
-- figures, and, for the 280 analysed municipalities, the groups and first two principal
-- components. log_population is derived in the export.
{% set kolada = ['out_commuting_pct', 'in_commuting_pct', 'dependency_ratio', 'post_secondary_25_64_pct'] %}
with points as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_similarity_points') }}
), kolada as (
    select
        municipality_code,
        {% for f in kolada %}
        max(value) filter (where feature = '{{ f }}') as {{ f }}{{ ',' if not loop.last }}
        {% endfor %}
    from {{ ref('stg_similarity_kolada') }}
    group by all
)
select
    p.municipality_code,
    p.year,
    p.municipality_name,
    p.county_name,
    p.population,
    p.open_unemployment_18_65_pct,
    p.employment_rate_20_64_pct,
    p.ill_health_days,
    p.median_earned_income_sek,
    p.social_assistance_pct,
    p.turnout_riksdag_pct,
    p.eligible_vocational_programme_pct,
    {% for f in kolada %}
    k.{{ f }},
    {% endfor %}
    pt.group_id,
    pt.finer_group,
    pt.skr_group,
    pt.pc1,
    pt.pc2
from {{ ref('stg_similarity_panel') }} as p
join (select distinct year from points) as r on r.year = p.year
left join kolada as k on k.municipality_code = p.municipality_code
left join points as pt on pt.municipality_code = p.municipality_code

nodes.subject: news

columns.name: item_id
columns.description: Key: source plus ':' plus the feed's guid or id, or the item URL when it has none.

columns.name: source
columns.description: Attribute: the feed: svt, ekot or regeringen.

columns.name: url
columns.description: Attribute: link to the item.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Attribute: headline of the item.

columns.name: summary
columns.description: Attribute: the feed's summary; null when empty.

columns.name: published_at
columns.description: Attribute: publication time from the feed; first_seen when the feed gives none.

columns.name: first_seen
columns.description: Attribute: time the item was first fetched.

columns.description: Attribute: sorted list of parties the item names, from fct_news_item_party; empty when none.

columns.name: topics
columns.description: Attribute: sorted list of topics the item is about, from fct_news_item_topic; empty when none.

columns.name: is_political
columns.description: Attribute: true when from regeringen, names a party, is about forming a government, or uses words of national politics.

nodes.sql:
-- News items with the parties and topics they concern. An item is political when it comes
-- from the Government, names a party, is about forming a government, or uses the words of
-- national politics; the site shows only those.
with parties as (
    select item_id, list(party order by party) as parties
    from {{ ref('fct_news_item_party') }} group by item_id
), topics as (
    select item_id, list(topic order by topic) as topics
    from {{ ref('fct_news_item_topic') }} group by item_id
)
select
    n.item_id,
    n.source,
    n.title,
    n.summary,
    n.url,
    coalesce(n.published_at, n.first_seen) as published_at,
    n.first_seen,
    coalesce(p.parties, []) as parties,
    coalesce(t.topics, []) as topics,
    (n.source = 'regeringen'
     or p.parties is not null
     or list_contains(coalesce(t.topics, []), 'regeringsbildning')
     or regexp_matches(lower(n.text),
        'regering|riksdag|minister|partiledare|opposition|proposition|utredning|budgetförhandling')
    ) as is_political
from {{ ref('stg_news_items') }} as n
left join parties as p using (item_id)
left join topics as t using (item_id)

columns.description: Key, references dim_party: a party the item names.
tests: accepted values: S, M, SD, V, C, KD, MP, L

columns.name: item_id
columns.description: Key: the news item; references fct_news_item.

columns.name: via
columns.description: Attribute: how the party was found: name (a politician in office) when that matched, term (a party term) otherwise.

nodes.sql:
-- The parties a news item names: by the way newsrooms write them, "(S)", "S-ledaren",
-- "SD:s", "Vänsterpartiet", "Tidöpartierna" (seeds/news/news_party_terms.csv, case-sensitive),
-- or by the full name of a politician in office now, for the news that names a minister
-- without the party ("Ebba Busch", "socialminister Jakob Forssmed"). `via` says which.
with by_term as (
    select distinct n.item_id, t.party, 'term' as via
    from {{ ref('stg_news_items') }} as n
    join {{ ref('news_party_terms') }} as t
        on regexp_matches(n.text, t.pattern)
), by_name as (
    select distinct n.item_id, p.party, 'name' as via
    from {{ ref('stg_news_items') }} as n
    join {{ ref('stg_news_people') }} as p
        on contains(n.text, p.name)
       and regexp_matches(n.text, '\b' || regexp_escape(p.name) || '(s|:s)?\b')
)
select item_id, party, min(via) as via
from (select * from by_term union all select * from by_name)
group by item_id, party

columns.description: Key: the vote id, plus ':motiv' for a roll call on the reasons for a decision (motivfrågan); unique within a session.

columns.name: vote_id
columns.description: Attribute: Riksdagen's vote id; one id can carry both the substantive and the motivfrågan roll call.

columns.name: is_substantive
columns.description: Attribute: true for a roll call on the decision itself, false for one on its reasons (motivfrågan).

columns.name: vote_date
columns.description: Attribute: date of the roll call; the report's decision date when the source gives none.

columns.name: issue_key
columns.description: Foreign key to dim_issue: the policy issue of the roll call's committee; null for committee 'ovrigt'.

columns.name: members
columns.description: Measure, additive: count of the party's members listed on the roll call.

columns.name: present
columns.description: Measure, additive: count of the party's members not absent (members minus absent).

columns.description: Measure, additive: count of the party's members voting yes.

columns.name: no
columns.description: Measure, additive: count of the party's members voting no.

columns.name: abstain
columns.description: Measure, additive: count of the party's members abstaining.

columns.name: absent
columns.description: Measure, additive: count of the party's members absent.

columns.name: position
columns.description: Attribute: the option most present members chose (yes, no, abstain); absent when all were absent, split on a tie.

columns.name: cohesion
columns.description: Measure, non-additive: share of present members voting with the party's plurality, fraction 0-1; null when none present.

columns.name: role
columns.description: Attribute: government, agreement or opposition, the party's role on the roll call's date.

columns.name: on_winning_side
columns.description: Attribute: true when the party's position was yes or no and matched the outcome.

columns.name: with_government
columns.description: Attribute: true when the party's position was yes or no and matched the prime minister's party.

nodes.sql:
-- How each party voted on each roll call, and the party's role that day: in government, in a
-- written agreement with the government, or in opposition.
select
    p.session, p.roll_call_id, r.vote_id, r.is_substantive, p.party, r.vote_date, r.issue_key,
    p.members, p.present, p.yes, p.no, p.abstain, p.absent, p.position, p.cohesion,
    case when list_contains(g.government_parties, p.party) then 'government'
         when list_contains(coalesce(g.agreement_parties, []), p.party) then 'agreement'
         else 'opposition' end as role,
    p.position in ('yes', 'no') and p.position = r.outcome as on_winning_side,
    p.position in ('yes', 'no') and p.position = r.government_position as with_government
from {{ ref('int_parliament_party_roll_calls') }} as p
join {{ ref('fct_roll_call') }} as r using (session, roll_call_id)
left join {{ ref('dim_government') }} as g using (government_key)

columns.name: government_won

nodes.sql:
-- Every roll call in the Riksdag since 1993/94: what it concerned, how it went, and whether the
-- government's side won. The government's position is that of the prime minister's party.
select
    r.session, r.roll_call_id, r.vote_id, r.is_substantive, r.is_complete, r.designation, r.point, r.subject, r.vote_date,
    r.committee_key, c.committee_code, c.committee_name, c.issue_key,
    r.report_title, r.report_headline, r.document_id, r.report_url,
    r.members, r.yes, r.no, r.abstain, r.absent, r.outcome,
    g.government_key,
    pm.position as government_position,
    case when pm.position in ('yes', 'no') then pm.position = r.outcome end as government_won
from {{ ref('int_parliament_roll_calls') }} as r
left join {{ ref('dim_committee') }} as c using (committee_key)
left join {{ ref('dim_government') }} as g
    on r.vote_date >= g.start_date and r.vote_date < coalesce(g.end_date, date '9999-12-31')
left join {{ ref('int_parliament_party_roll_calls') }} as pm
    on pm.session = r.session and pm.roll_call_id = r.roll_call_id and pm.party = g.prime_minister_party

nodes.name: fct_sfs_document
nodes.subject: sfs
nodes.description: One row per document in Riksdagen's SFS list (int_sfs_documents) with its numbered paragraphs and passages from int_sfs_corpus_paragraphs. Read by platform/publish/export_sfs.py for the statute-book page.

columns.name: dok_id
columns.description: Key: Riksdagen's document id, unique where the SFS number is not.

columns.name: kind
columns.description: Attribute: lag, förordning or other, from the first word of the title; grundlagar and Riksdagsordningen count as lag.

columns.description: Attribute: year of issued.

columns.name: is_repealed
columns.description: The repeal date is on or before the fetch date; false when there is none.

columns.name: repealed_year
columns.description: The year of repeal, for repealed documents only.

columns.name: sections
columns.description: Distinct numbered paragraphs (chapter and §).

columns.name: paragraph_passages
columns.description: Paragraph rows in int_sfs_corpus_paragraphs; a long § gives one per stycke.

columns.name: whole_text_passages
columns.description: Whole-text passages, for a document with no numbered paragraph.

columns.name: sfs
columns.description: Attribute: SFS number (beteckning), such as 2010:800; not unique.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Attribute: title of the document, whitespace collapsed.

columns.name: issued
columns.description: Attribute: date of issue from Riksdagen's list; null when unparsable.

columns.name: repealed_on
columns.description: Attribute: repeal date from the text header (Upphävd); null when none or no text.

columns.name: has_text
columns.description: Attribute: true when the document's text was fetched.

columns.name: parse_status
columns.description: Attribute: parsed, unnumbered (no numbered §), failed (numbered § but none split out) or no text.

columns.name: text_chars
columns.description: Measure, additive: characters in the fetched text; null when there is no text.

columns.name: fetched_at
columns.description: Attribute: time the text was fetched; null when there is no text.

nodes.sql:
-- One row per document in Riksdagen's SFS list, with what the statute-book page counts:
-- kind, year of issue and repeal, whether the text was fetched, and its numbered paragraphs (§)
-- and passages. A § split into stycken counts once in sections and once per stycke in
-- paragraph_passages.
with passages as (
    select
        dok_id,
        count(distinct coalesce(chapter, '') || '|' || paragraph)
            filter (where kind = 'paragraph') as sections,
        count(*) filter (where kind = 'paragraph') as paragraph_passages,
        count(*) filter (where kind = 'whole_text') as whole_text_passages
    from {{ ref('int_sfs_corpus_paragraphs') }}
    group by dok_id
)

select
    d.dok_id,
    d.sfs,
    d.title,
    d.kind,
    d.issued,
    year(d.issued) as issued_year,
    d.repealed_on,
    coalesce(d.is_repealed, false) as is_repealed,
    case when d.is_repealed then year(d.repealed_on) end as repealed_year,
    d.has_text,
    d.parse_status,
    d.text_chars,
    d.fetched_at,
    coalesce(p.sections, 0) as sections,
    coalesce(p.paragraph_passages, 0) as paragraph_passages,
    coalesce(p.whole_text_passages, 0) as whole_text_passages
from {{ ref('int_sfs_documents') }} as d
left join passages as p on p.dok_id = d.dok_id

-- The studies behind each tax decision: those its bill names as preparation. In a budget bill,
-- only those named in the preparation of the decision's own proposal (e.g. 12.1 for 12.1.3);
-- none where the decision's section is not known, rather than every study the bill names.

nodes.name: int_ai_act_article_actors
nodes.subject: ai_act
nodes.description: Article × actor mentions and "shall" sentences in the current English text (derived by pattern).
nodes.sql:
"""Which actors each current article mentions, and where the text says an actor "shall".

Derived by pattern from the current English text, with the patterns in
seeds/eu_ai_act/ai_act_actors.csv (`match_pattern`). Two counts per article and actor:
`mentions` (the term appears) and `duty_sentences` (a sentence where the term is followed,
within the same clause, by "shall"). This is a signal for navigation, not a legal reading:
an article can mention an actor without imposing anything on it.
"""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

METHOD = "term-match-v1"


def model(dbt, session):
    dbt.config(materialized="table")
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd()))

    provisions = dbt.ref("int_ai_act_provisions").df()
    documents = dbt.ref("int_ai_act_documents").df()
    actors = dbt.ref("ai_act_actors").df()
    current = documents.loc[documents["is_current"], "celex"].iloc[0]
    articles = provisions[(provisions["version_celex"] == current) & (provisions["language"] == "en")
                          & (provisions["provision_kind"] == "article")]
    rows = []
    for a in articles.itertuples():
        sentences = re.split(r"(?<=[.;:])\s+", a.text)
        for actor in actors.itertuples():
            pattern = re.compile(actor.match_pattern, re.I)
            mentions = len(pattern.findall(a.text))
            if not mentions:
                continue
            duty = sum(1 for s in sentences
                       if (m := pattern.search(s)) and re.search(r"\bshall\b", s[m.end():m.end() + 160]))
            rows.append({
                "article_number": a.number,
                "actor_id": actor.actor_id,
                "mentions": mentions,
                "duty_sentences": duty,
                "method": METHOD,
                "version_celex": current,
            })
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)
